items.why: The guess captures a generic two-opposing-forces contrast with Transylvania and London, but the narration is about a size-contrast visual and the first phase of the plan, so it only partly fits and leans on the title.
Men giving blood with Quincey stepping forward matches the narration of the men pooling their blood.
Dracula versus typewriter as opposing forces matches the size-contrast setup of the vast monster against the small machine.
Ancient warlord with a telepathic mind matches the narration.
The typewriter and filing system as the weapon that defeats the monster matches the narration.
Mina waiting for Jonathan away in Transylvania while preparing herself matches the narration.
Mina as the analytical nerve center of the London group against Dracula matches the narration.
Fifty boxes of earth matches the narration about 50 massive boxes, with the shipping to England being a reasonable gloss.
Stoker writing in 1897 about reverse colonization matches the narration.
Dracula hiding behind shell companies matches the narration.
